widget.name: Kanban Drag And Drop
widget.description: Drag cards between lanes with templated lane/card content.

property.caption: Lane data
property.description: Datasource returning Lane objects.

property.caption: Lane sort key
property.description: Determines lane order.

property.caption: Lane identifier
property.description: Unique lane id (passed to on drop flow).

property.caption: Lane card count
property.description: Attribute holding the total number of cards that belong to this lane (e.g. an aggregate attribute). Lets the widget tell a genuinely empty lane apart from a lane whose cards simply haven't been fetched yet.

property.caption: Car data
property.description: Datasource returning Card objects.

property.caption: Card sort key
property.description: Order within a lane.

property.caption: Card → Lane
property.description: Reference from Card to Lane.

property.caption: Initial card limit
property.description: Number of cards fetched first load (board-wide). Keep this to a few pages worth of cards for best performance with large boards.

property.caption: Load more batch size
property.description: How many additional cards to fetch each time "load more" is triggered.

property.caption: Load more mode
property.description: How to reveal additional cards.

property.caption: Minimum cards per lane
property.description: Used in "Auto-load on scroll" mode. A lane with fewer loaded cards than this (but with more available, per "Lane card count") has no scrollbar to trigger a load, so it keeps auto-loading until it reaches this minimum. Set to 0 to disable.

property.caption: Load more label
property.description: Text shown on the load more button (used in "Load more button" mode).

property.caption: Target lane id
property.description: Attribute to receive the target lane identifier.

property.caption: New sort key
property.description: Attribute (decimal) to receive the new sort key for the card.

property.caption: On drop action
property.description: Select microflow to update the Card SortKey and the Card→Lane association.

property.caption: Lane header (Lane)
property.description: Widgets rendered in each lane header (Lane context).

property.caption: Card body (Card)
property.description: Widgets rendered inside each card (Card context).

property.caption: Render type
property.description: Determines whether the view will be rendered vertically or horizontally

property.caption: Lane width (CSS)
property.description: Width of each lane. Accepts CSS values like "500px", "40%".

property.caption: Lane body height (CSS)
property.description: Height of each lane's scrollable card area. Accepts CSS values like "600px", "80vh" or "calc(100% - 70px)".

property.caption: Enable footer
property.description: Show a custom section at the bottom of each lane.

property.caption: Enable empty section
property.description: Show a custom section when there are no cards in the lane.

property.caption: Empty sheet content (Lane)
property.description: Section to place custom content when lane is empty.

property.caption: Bottom sheet content
property.description: Section to place custom content for the bottom of each lane.
